settings.editor:
Plastic-Craft supplies plastics that make vehicles lighter, safer, and more fuel efficient. Automotive and transportation companies choose our materials because they provide consistent quality and adaptability across cars, trucks, buses, trains, RVs, and marine applications.

Our plastics reduce vehicle weight while maintaining strength, cutting fuel consumption and emissions. They resist corrosion, impact, and wear, making them ideal for powertrain parts, body panels, glazing, and interior components. Transportation systems benefit from our durable plastics in bus windows, railcar panels, truck liners, and marine decking. Plastic-Craft helps manufacturers achieve long-term reliability, safety, and design flexibility in both consumer and commercial transport.

<style>
/* ============================================================
   Plastic-Craft Industries — Global Stylesheet
   Brand Kit Colors & Typography
   ============================================================ */

/* --- Google / Web Fonts --- */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Alice&display=swap');

/* Peace Sans — commercial font, loaded locally with fallback */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Peace Sans';
  src: url('../fonts/PeaceSans.woff2') format('woff2'),
       url('../fonts/PeaceSans.woff')  format('woff');
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Weiss — commercial font with fallback */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Weiss';
  src: url('../fonts/Weiss.woff2') format('woff2'),
       url('../fonts/Weiss.woff')  format('woff');
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Copperplate Gothic 29 BC — commercial font with fallback */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Copperplate Gothic 29 BC';
  src: url('../fonts/CopperplateGothic29BC.woff2') format('woff2'),
       url('../fonts/CopperplateGothic29BC.woff')  format('woff');
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* --- CSS Custom Properties (Brand Tokens) --- */
:root {
  /* Primary Palette */
  --color-primary:          #1380da;
  --color-primary-light:    #64b7f0;
  --color-primary-pale:     #d0e9fd;
  --color-primary-bright:   #2e8eff;
  --color-accent-blue:      #031aec;
  --color-accent-indigo:    #0b108b;

  /* Dark / Navy */
  --color-navy:             #07276e;
  --color-navy-deep:        #03325e;

  /* Neutrals */
  --color-white:            #ffffff;
  --color-gray:             #666666;
  --color-gray-blue:        #83b1d1;
  --color-gray-light:       #d4e1ed;

  /* Typography Families */
  --font-title:      'Peace Sans', 'Montserrat', 'Arial Black', sans-serif;
  --font-subtitle:   'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  --font-heading:    'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  --font-subheading: 'Weiss', 'Garamond', 'Times New Roman', serif;
  --font-section:    'Alice', 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  --font-body:       'Times New Roman', Times, serif;
  --font-quote:      'Copperplate Gothic 29 BC', 'Copperplate', serif;
  --font-caption:    'Times New Roman', Times, serif;

  /* Spacing Scale */
  --space-xs:  0.5rem;
  --space-sm:  1rem;
  --space-md:  1.5rem;
  --space-lg:  2.5rem;
  --space-xl:  4rem;
  --space-2xl: 6rem;

  /* Layout */
  --max-width:    1200px;
  --border-radius: 6px;

  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-sm:  0 1px 3px rgba(3, 50, 94, 0.08);
  --shadow-md:  0 4px 12px rgba(3, 50, 94, 0.12);
  --shadow-lg:  0 8px 30px rgba(3, 50, 94, 0.16);
}

/* --- Reset & Base --- */
*,
*::before,
*::after {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  font-size: 16px;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  background-color: var(--color-white);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

a {
  color: var(--color-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.25s ease;
}

a:hover {
  color: var(--color-accent-blue);
}

/* --- Utility --- */
.container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 var(--space-md);
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
  border: 0;
}

/* ============================================================
   HEADER / NAVIGATION
   ============================================================ */
.site-header {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  padding: var(--space-sm) 0;
}

.site-header .container {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.site-header__logo {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  color: var(--color-white);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.site-header__logo span {
  color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.site-header__nav {
  display: flex;
  list-style: none;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}

.site-header__nav a {
  font-family: var(--font-section);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  transition: color 0.25s ease;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.site-header__nav a:hover,
.site-header__nav a.active {
  color: var(--color-white);
}

/* Mobile nav toggle */
.nav-toggle {
  display: none;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: var(--space-xs);
}

.nav-toggle span {
  display: block;
  width: 26px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--color-white);
  margin: 5px 0;
  transition: 0.3s;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO SECTION  (matches wireframe: full-width dark banner)
   ============================================================ */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--color-navy-deep) 0%, var(--color-navy) 60%, #0d4a8a 100%);
  color: var(--color-white);
  padding: 8rem 0 5rem;
  text-align: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 100%, rgba(19,128,218,0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 0%, rgba(100,183,240,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Subtle geometric pattern overlay */
.hero::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(30deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 12%, transparent 12.5%, transparent 87%, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 87.5%),
    linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 12%, transparent 12.5%, transparent 87%, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 87.5%);
  background-size: 80px 140px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero__content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.hero__label {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-quote);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-primary-light);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.hero__title {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4rem);
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.hero__divider {
  width: 80px;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--color-primary-light);
  margin: var(--space-md) auto;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.hero__subtitle {
  font-family: var(--font-subtitle);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--color-gray-light);
  max-width: 650px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO IMAGE SECTION  (placeholder image banner, compact)
   ============================================================ */
.hero-image {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 280px;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.hero-image__overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(3,50,94,0.55) 0%, rgba(3,50,94,0.15) 100%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-md);
}

.hero-image__title {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
  color: var(--color-white);
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO — Background-image variant (left-aligned, smaller title)
   Applied via .hero--image modifier class
   ============================================================ */
.hero--image {
  min-height: 420px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  text-align: left;
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
}

.hero--image::before {
  background: linear-gradient(
    to top,
    rgba(3, 50, 94, 0.82) 0%,
    rgba(3, 50, 94, 0.45) 40%,
    rgba(3, 50, 94, 0.20) 100%
  );
}

.hero--image .hero__content {
  text-align: left;
  padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
}

.hero--image .hero__title {
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.4rem);
}

.hero--image .hero__divider {
  width: 60px;
  margin: 0;
}

/* ============================================================
   INTRO — Tight / single-spaced variant
   Applied via .intro--tight modifier class
   ============================================================ */
.intro--tight {
  text-align: left;
}

.intro--tight .intro__content p {
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin-bottom: 0.35em;
}

/* ============================================================
   INTRO TEXT SECTION  (centered text block below hero)
   ============================================================ */
.intro {
  padding: var(--space-xl) 0;
  background: var(--color-white);
  text-align: center;
}

.intro__content {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.intro__content p {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
  color: var(--color-gray);
  line-height: 1.85;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.intro__content p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ============================================================
   APPLICATIONS SECTION  (image left + tabbed list right)
   ============================================================ */
.applications {
  padding: var(--space-2xl) 0 var(--space-xl);
  background: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--color-primary-pale) 0%, #e8f3fc 40%, var(--color-white) 100%);
}

.applications__layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  align-items: start;
}

.applications__image {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.applications__image img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 480px;
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* Blue-tint overlay on image */
.applications__image::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(3,50,94,0.05) 0%, rgba(3,50,94,0.25) 100%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.applications__body h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

/* Tabs */
.applications__tabs {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.applications__tab {
  font-family: var(--font-section);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  padding: 0.5em 1.2em;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-gray-light);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  background: var(--color-white);
  color: var(--color-gray);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.applications__tab:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-primary-light);
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.applications__tab.active {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

/* Panels */
.applications__panel {
  display: none;
}

.applications__panel.active {
  display: block;
  animation: fadeIn 0.35s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.applications__list {
  list-style: none;
}

.applications__list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.75em;
  padding: 0.55em 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(3,50,94,0.06);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.applications__list li:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.applications__list li::before {
  content: '';
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  background: var(--color-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-top: 0.5em;
}

/* ============================================================
   MATERIALS SECTION  (teal/blue banner bar + tag grid)
   ============================================================ */
.materials {
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--color-white);
}

.materials__banner {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-navy-deep) 0%, var(--color-navy) 60%, var(--color-primary) 100%);
  padding: var(--space-lg) 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.materials__banner h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  color: var(--color-white);
  margin-bottom: 0.2em;
}

.materials__banner p {
  font-family: var(--font-subheading);
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--color-gray-blue);
}

.materials__grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-md);
  max-width: var(--max-width);
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.material-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4em;
  font-family: var(--font-section);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  border: 1px solid rgba(19,128,218,0.15);
  padding: 0.6em 1.4em;
  border-radius: 50px;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  cursor: default;
}

.material-tag:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-white);
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

/* ============================================================
   ADVANTAGES SECTION  (card carousel row + dots)
   ============================================================ */
.advantages {
  padding: var(--space-2xl) 0;
  background: var(--color-gray-light);
}

.advantages__header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}

.advantages__header h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.advantages__header p {
  font-family: var(--font-subheading);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--color-gray);
}

/* Carousel wrapper */
.advantages__carousel {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.advantages__track {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  transition: transform 0.45s ease;
}

.advantage-card {
  flex: 0 0 calc(33.333% - var(--space-md) * 2 / 3);
  background: var(--color-white);
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  border-top: 4px solid var(--color-primary);
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
}

.advantage-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.advantage-card__icon {
  width: 50px;
  height: 50px;
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.advantage-card__icon svg {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  stroke: var(--color-primary);
  fill: none;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.advantage-card h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-section);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  margin-bottom: 0.4em;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.advantage-card p {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.93rem;
  color: var(--color-gray);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

/* Carousel dots */
.advantages__dots {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: var(--space-lg);
}

.advantages__dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-gray-blue);
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.25s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
  padding: 0;
}

.advantages__dot.active {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  transform: scale(1.25);
}

.advantages__dot:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary-light);
}

/* Carousel arrows */
.advantages__arrow {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-gray-blue);
  background: var(--color-white);
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: 2;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.advantages__arrow:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.advantages__arrow--prev {
  left: -12px;
}

.advantages__arrow--next {
  right: -12px;
}

/* ============================================================
   CTA / CONTACT SECTION  (light blue bottom bar)
   ============================================================ */
.cta-section {
  padding: var(--space-2xl) 0;
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  text-align: center;
}

.cta-section h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.cta-section p {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--color-gray);
  max-width: 620px;
  margin: 0 auto var(--space-lg);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.cta-section__actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5em;
  font-family: var(--font-section);
  font-size: 1rem;
  padding: 0.85em 2.2em;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.btn--primary {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-white);
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.btn--primary:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary-bright);
  border-color: var(--color-primary-bright);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

.btn--outline {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-navy-deep);
  border-color: var(--color-navy-deep);
}

.btn--outline:hover {
  background: var(--color-navy-deep);
  color: var(--color-white);
}

/* ============================================================
   FOOTER
   ============================================================ */
.site-footer {
  background: var(--color-navy-deep);
  color: var(--color-gray-blue);
  padding: var(--space-xl) 0 var(--space-md);
}

.site-footer__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.site-footer__brand {
  font-family: var(--font-title);
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  color: var(--color-white);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.site-footer__brand span {
  color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.site-footer__desc {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--color-gray-blue);
}

.site-footer h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-section);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--color-white);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.site-footer ul {
  list-style: none;
}

.site-footer ul li {
  margin-bottom: 0.5em;
}

.site-footer ul a {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--color-gray-blue);
  transition: color 0.25s ease;
}

.site-footer ul a:hover {
  color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.site-footer__bottom {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  padding-top: var(--space-md);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.site-footer__copyright {
  font-family: var(--font-caption);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .applications__layout {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-lg);
  }

  .applications__image img {
    height: 350px;
  }

  .advantage-card {
    flex: 0 0 calc(50% - var(--space-md) / 2);
  }

  .site-footer__grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .hero {
    padding: 6rem 0 3.5rem;
  }

  .hero--image {
    min-height: 320px;
    padding: 0;
  }
